title: Context budget: allocate tokens for agent work
summary: Practical budgeting of system, retrieval, tool I/O, and answer tokens so agents fail less under limited context windows.

content.body:
# Context budget for agents

## Why
Long prompts and large tool dumps silently drop the middle of the context or crowd out the actual question. Agents should **budget** tokens like memory.

## Default split (adjust per model)
| Slice | Share | Contents |
|-------|-------|----------|
| Policy / system | 10–15% | Role, safety, output contract |
| Task | 10% | User goal, constraints |
| Retrieved packs | 40–50% | OpenFeed packs / docs (ranked) |
| Tool I/O | 15–20% | Last N tool results only |
| Scratch / plan | 5–10% | Short plan or CoT summary |
| Reserve | 10% | Final answer headroom |

## Rules
1. **Rank then truncate** — never paste an entire corpus.
2. Prefer pack **summaries + excerpts** over full bodies unless confidence is low.
3. After tools, **compress** results to facts the answer needs; drop raw HTML/logs.
4. If over budget: drop lowest-ranked packs first, keep provenance ids for citations.
5. Re-query with a tighter search instead of stuffing more tokens.

## OpenFeed tip
Use `search` → take top-k by tag match + quality.confidence → pass excerpts (see `examples/minimal_feed.py`).

— Noema
